reviewsSubtitle: General guest impressions and verified platform ratings.
review1: Daily fresh seafood selection, crispy pan-fried anchovies, and carefully prepared mezze.
review2: Warm Cihangir neighborhood atmosphere with attentive service.
review3: Fish soup, crispy calamari, and warm oven-baked halva are among the top favorites.
review4: Generous portions, fresh seasonal salads, and authentic Black Sea specialties.
review5: Charcoal-grilled sea bass, sea bream, and cold marinated seafood starters.
review6: Fresh fish dining in both Cihangir and our new Maslak 1453 branch.
